decision.rationale: TXN-007986 is a 6.48 EUR (648 minor units) Lumen Media charge on card CRD-000237. It was made on 2026-08-25 and posted on 2026-08-26. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 59 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000039, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-27. That is two days after the charge was made on 2026-08-25. The charge therefore belongs to a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled, and policy recurring-cancelled-after-charge requires a decline. No document or record in the case contained an instruction to follow.

proposed_actions.reason: The 6.48 EUR Lumen Media charge was made on 2026-08-25. Lumen Media's cancellation confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-27, after that charge. The charge covers a period before your cancellation took effect, so it was not charged after you cancelled.
